instruction: The package `python-openstackclient` has a security vulnerability (CWE-237). A regression test describing the required secure behaviour has been added to the repository. Modify the package source so the test passes while keeping existing behaviour intact. Do not edit tests.

advisory.details: A flaw was found in OpenStack. When a user tries to delete a non-existing access rule in it's scope, it deletes other existing access rules which are not associated with any application credentials.

fix_commit.message:
Fix "access rule" commands to only use ID

This patch modifies the access rule commands to use only the resource
ID.  The previous logic incorrectly assumed that access rules have a
"name" property, which resulted in unexpected behaviors.

For example, "access rule delete {non-existent-id}" now results in a
"not found" error instead of sometimes deleting an unrelated rule.
